effect: The shim corrected the sideways lean, and the repeat test confirmed that the marble reaches the catch cup. The chapter goal is complete.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the specific cause of the trap fixed and tested.

mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the marble and then correcting the tilt was most worthwhile: the trapped marble made the role of the shim and the direction of the slope clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the launcher was a straightforward necessary step, but its result was less interesting than the mechanism explanation or the test.

surprise.text: The marble returning downhill but getting trapped by a sideways lean changed my understanding of what levelling mattered.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; even the shim had a clear purpose after the test.

continue.text: Yes. The trap and its correction made me curious about what Jo might add for the marble to do along the way.
